description: This file contains implementation of profiling record management for Torch JIT, including registration of profiling nodes, shape profiling, and graph instrumentation.

classes.name: ProfileRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration and decision logic for profiling nodes.

classes.name: ProfilingRecord
classes.description: Handles creation, insertion, and removal of profiling nodes within a Torch JIT graph.

methods.name: shouldProfileNode
methods.description: Determines if a node should be profiled.

methods.name: bindSymbolicShapes
methods.description: Binds symbolic shapes to concrete sizes.

methods.name: createProfileNode
methods.description: Creates a profiling node with a callback.

methods.name: createProfileIValueNode
methods.description: Creates a profiling node for IValue input.

methods.name: insertShapeProfile
methods.description: Inserts shape profiling nodes into the graph.

methods.name: instrumentBlock
methods.description: Instruments a block with profiling nodes.

methods.name: removeProfilingNodes
methods.description: Removes profiling nodes from a block.

methods.name: instrumentGraph
methods.description: Instruments an entire graph with profiling nodes.
